report_metadata.project_title: Security Audit of a Computer System (WinSecAudit)

executive_assessment.executive_summary: The Windows Security Audit evaluated 31 security controls across 5 core domains, achieving an overall security score of 86.0/100 (Elevated Risk (Action Required)). In total, 25 checks passed, 3 failed, 2 raised warnings, and 1 could not be assessed under the current privilege level. Key areas requiring attention include 1 Critical and 2 High severity findings.
executive_assessment.methodology: Scoring Allocation: User Accounts (20 pts), System Updates (20 pts), File Permissions (20 pts), Running Services (15 pts), Security Configurations (25 pts). Severity Weights: Critical=10, High=6, Medium=3, Low=1. PASS awards 100% of check weight, WARNING awards 50%, FAIL awards 0%. Checks marked NOT_ASSESSED (e.g., due to non-administrative privilege context) are excluded from the denominator.

identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.title: Password Requirement on Enabled Accounts
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.description: Check if any enabled local user accounts do not require a password.
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.explanation: Accounts that do not require a password allow trivial unauthorized local login and privilege escalation.
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.remediation: Set a strong password and enforce PasswordRequired on all enabled local user accounts.

identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.title: System Minimum Password Length Policy
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.description: Verify that Windows Local Security Policy enforces a minimum password length (>= 8 chars).
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.evidence: net accounts reports Minimum password length: 0 characters.
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.explanation: A minimum password length of 0 permits blank or short passwords that can be cracked instantaneously.
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.remediation: Configure Minimum Password Length to at least 12 characters via secpol.msc or 'net accounts /minpwlen:12' (as Administrator).

identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.title: Unquoted Service Binary Paths (CWE-428)
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.description: Check all Windows services for unquoted executable paths containing spaces.
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.evidence: Detected 1 service(s) with unquoted paths containing spaces: UpcElevationService (C:\Program Files (x86)\Ubisoft\Ubisoft Game Launcher Core\UpcElevationService.exe)
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.explanation: When a service path contains spaces and is unquoted, Windows attempts to execute binaries at each space boundary (e.g. C:\Program.exe), enabling privilege escalation if a parent folder is writable.
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.remediation: Wrap the ImagePath registry value in double quotes for each affected service in HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services.

identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.title: Print Spooler Service Status
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.description: Assess whether the Windows Print Spooler service (Spooler) is active and running as LocalSystem.
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.evidence: Print Spooler (Spooler) is Running as 'LocalSystem' (StartMode: Auto).
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.explanation: Print Spooler runs as LocalSystem by default. While needed for local printing, it has historically been a frequent vector for privilege escalation (e.g., PrintNightmare).
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.remediation: If printing is not required on this machine, disable the Spooler service or disable 'Allow Print Spooler to accept client connections' in Group Policy.

identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.title: Third-Party Services Running as LocalSystem
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.description: Evaluate non-Windows services executing with unrestricted LocalSystem privileges.
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.evidence: 15 third-party services are running as LocalSystem (including: LenovoVantageService, DAService, EABackgroundService, GameInputRedistService, GamingServices, HidHideWatchdog.exe). Total LocalSystem running services: 91/135.
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.explanation: Every third-party service running as LocalSystem represents full OS compromise if a vulnerability exists in that vendor daemon.
identified_vulnerabilities_and_weaknesse.remediation: Audit third-party background services and uninstall unused software or downgrade service accounts to LocalService where supported.

all_checks.title: Built-in Guest Account Status
all_checks.description: Verify that the built-in Windows Guest account is disabled.
all_checks.evidence: Account 'Guest' (SID: S-1-5-21-1301171905-3339115337-1909463598-501) is Disabled (Enabled = False).
all_checks.explanation: Disabling the Guest account prevents anonymous local and network access.
all_checks.remediation: No action required. Maintain Guest account in disabled state.

all_checks.title: Built-in Administrator Account (RID 500) Status
all_checks.description: Check whether the default built-in Administrator account is disabled.
all_checks.evidence: Built-in Administrator 'Administrator' (SID: S-1-5-21-1301171905-3339115337-1909463598-500) is Disabled.
all_checks.explanation: Keeping the built-in Administrator account disabled reduces the attack surface for RID-500 brute-force attacks.
all_checks.remediation: No action required.

all_checks.title: Administrative Privilege Minimization
all_checks.description: Ensure only essential accounts are members of the local Administrators group.
all_checks.evidence: 1 enabled Administrator account(s) detected: demo_student.
all_checks.explanation: Restricting administrative privileges to a single administrative identity adheres to the Principle of Least Privilege.
all_checks.remediation: Continue using Standard User accounts for routine non-administrative tasks.

all_checks.title: Password Requirement on Enabled Accounts
all_checks.description: Check if any enabled local user accounts do not require a password.
all_checks.evidence: Enabled account(s) with PasswordRequired=False: demo_student
all_checks.explanation: Accounts that do not require a password allow trivial unauthorized local login and privilege escalation.
all_checks.remediation: Set a strong password and enforce PasswordRequired on all enabled local user accounts.

all_checks.title: Password Expiration Policy on Active Accounts
all_checks.description: Check whether active local user accounts have non-expiring passwords.
all_checks.evidence: All enabled user accounts enforce password expiration.
all_checks.explanation: Periodic credential rotation limits the window of exposure for leaked credentials.
all_checks.remediation: No action required.

all_checks.title: System Minimum Password Length Policy
all_checks.description: Verify that Windows Local Security Policy enforces a minimum password length (>= 8 chars).
all_checks.evidence: net accounts reports Minimum password length: 0 characters.
all_checks.explanation: A minimum password length of 0 permits blank or short passwords that can be cracked instantaneously.
all_checks.remediation: Configure Minimum Password Length to at least 12 characters via secpol.msc or 'net accounts /minpwlen:12' (as Administrator).

all_checks.title: Account Lockout Threshold Policy
all_checks.description: Verify that an account lockout threshold is configured to mitigate brute-force login attempts.
all_checks.evidence: net accounts reports Lockout threshold: 10 invalid attempts (Duration: 10 mins).
all_checks.explanation: An active account lockout policy automatically throttles automated password-spraying and brute-force attacks.
all_checks.remediation: No action required.

all_checks.title: Operating System Build Support & Currency

all_checks.evidence: Microsoft Windows 11 Home (Version 10.0.26200, Build 26200) is a modern supported Windows 11 servicing build.
all_checks.explanation: Running an actively supported Windows build ensures the kernel and system components receive monthly security patches.
all_checks.remediation: No action required. Maintain current feature update servicing channel.

all_checks.title: Installed Security Updates & Patch Recency
all_checks.description: Verify that Windows cumulative and security hotfixes are installed and recent.
all_checks.evidence: 5 hotfixes installed. Latest update KB5127648 installed on 2026-10-28 (8 days ago).
all_checks.explanation: Microsoft releases cumulative security updates monthly (Patch Tuesday). Updates within the last 45 days indicate healthy patch hygiene.
all_checks.remediation: Continue applying monthly cumulative updates.

all_checks.title: Pending Windows Updates Queue

all_checks.evidence: 0 pending software updates found in the local Windows Update cache.
all_checks.explanation: No uninstalled updates are waiting in the local update queue.
all_checks.remediation: No action required.

all_checks.title: Overly Broad 'Everyone' Write/FullControl Permissions
all_checks.description: Check whether the 'Everyone' security principal is granted write, modify, or full control on audited paths.
all_checks.evidence: 0 audited directories or files grant Write, Modify, or FullControl to 'Everyone'.
all_checks.explanation: Preventing 'Everyone' write access protects system integrity against unauthorized tampering.
all_checks.remediation: No action required.

all_checks.title: System32 and Program Files Write Protection
all_checks.description: Verify that standard users cannot modify binaries inside C:\Windows\System32 or C:\Program Files.
all_checks.evidence: C:\Windows\System32 and C:\Program Files restrict write/modify access to TrustedInstaller, SYSTEM, and Administrators.
all_checks.explanation: Strict ACLs on OS and application binary directories prevent local privilege escalation via binary replacement.
all_checks.remediation: No action required.

all_checks.title: All-Users Startup Directory Permission Hardening
all_checks.description: Verify that non-administrators cannot drop executables into the machine-wide Startup folder.
all_checks.evidence: Machine-wide Startup folder prevents write/modify operations by standard users.
all_checks.explanation: Securing the global Startup folder prevents cross-account persistence and privilege escalation.
all_checks.remediation: No action required.

all_checks.title: Windows DNS Hosts File ACL Protection
all_checks.description: Ensure standard non-administrative users cannot modify C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts.
all_checks.evidence: C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts is read-only for standard users and writable only by Administrators/SYSTEM.
all_checks.explanation: Protecting the hosts file prevents local DNS poisoning and security update redirection.
all_checks.remediation: No action required.

all_checks.title: Shared & Temporary Directory ACL Review
all_checks.description: Inspect C:\Users\Public and C:\Windows\Temp for excessive FullControl permissions granted to non-admin groups.
all_checks.evidence: C:\Users\Public and C:\Windows\Temp follow standard scoped NTFS inheritance without broad FullControl exposure.
all_checks.explanation: Properly scoped permissions on shared directories prevent cross-user file tampering.
all_checks.remediation: No action required.

all_checks.evidence: RemoteRegistry is Stopped (StartMode: Disabled).
all_checks.explanation: Keeping Remote Registry stopped prevents remote registry enumeration and lateral movement.

all_checks.evidence: Telnet (TlntSvr), FTP (FTPSVC), SNMP, and Simple TCP/IP services are not running.
all_checks.explanation: Disabling legacy cleartext daemons eliminates network credential sniffing and service exploitation vectors.
all_checks.remediation: No action required.

all_checks.evidence: Print Spooler (Spooler) is Running as 'LocalSystem' (StartMode: Auto).
all_checks.explanation: Print Spooler runs as LocalSystem by default. While needed for local printing, it has historically been a frequent vector for privilege escalation (e.g., PrintNightmare).
all_checks.remediation: If printing is not required on this machine, disable the Spooler service or disable 'Allow Print Spooler to accept client connections' in Group Policy.

all_checks.title: Third-Party Services Running as LocalSystem
all_checks.description: Evaluate non-Windows services executing with unrestricted LocalSystem privileges.
all_checks.evidence: 15 third-party services are running as LocalSystem (including: LenovoVantageService, DAService, EABackgroundService, GameInputRedistService, GamingServices, HidHideWatchdog.exe). Total LocalSystem running services: 91/135.

all_checks.title: Windows Defender Antivirus & Real-Time Protection
all_checks.description: Verify that Windows Defender Antivirus and Real-Time Malware Protection are active.
all_checks.evidence: AntivirusEnabled=True, RealTimeProtectionEnabled=True, BehaviorMonitorEnabled=True, IoavProtectionEnabled=True
all_checks.explanation: Real-Time Protection scans files and process memory on access to block malware execution before infection occurs.
all_checks.remediation: Enable Real-time protection in Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings.

all_checks.title: Windows Defender Security Intelligence Currency
all_checks.description: Verify that malware definitions (Security Intelligence) have been updated within the last 3 days.
all_checks.evidence: Signature Version: 1.463.134.0, AntivirusSignatureAge: 0 day(s).
all_checks.explanation: Outdated antivirus signatures reduce detection accuracy against newly emerging ransomware and trojans.
all_checks.remediation: Run 'Update-MpSignature' in PowerShell or check for protection updates in Windows Security.

all_checks.title: Windows Defender Tamper Protection
all_checks.description: Verify that Tamper Protection is enabled to prevent unauthorized modification of Defender settings.
all_checks.evidence: IsTamperProtected = True
all_checks.explanation: Tamper Protection prevents malware or scripts from disabling Windows Defender via registry or PowerShell.
all_checks.remediation: Enable Tamper Protection in Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings.

all_checks.title: Windows Defender Firewall Profile Status (Domain, Private, Public)
all_checks.description: Verify that the host firewall is enabled across Domain, Private, and Public network profiles.
all_checks.evidence: Domain: Enabled=True (In:NotConfigured), Private: Enabled=True (In:NotConfigured), Public: Enabled=True (In:NotConfigured)
all_checks.explanation: The host firewall blocks unsolicited inbound network connections and lateral movement attempts.
all_checks.remediation: Enable all firewall profiles via 'Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Public,Private -Enabled True' (as Administrator).

all_checks.title: User Account Control (UAC) & Secure Desktop Configuration
all_checks.description: Verify that UAC is enabled and prompts administrators on the Secure Desktop before privilege elevation.
all_checks.evidence: EnableLUA=1, ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=5, PromptOnSecureDesktop=1.
all_checks.explanation: UAC prevents silent privilege escalation by requiring interactive user consent on an isolated Secure Desktop.
all_checks.remediation: Set UAC to 'Notify me only when apps try to make changes to my computer (default)' or higher in User Account Control Settings.

all_checks.title: Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) & Network Level Authentication
all_checks.description: Check whether Remote Desktop is disabled, or if enabled, enforces Network Level Authentication (NLA).
all_checks.evidence: fDenyTSConnections = 1 (Remote Desktop connections are disabled).
all_checks.explanation: Exposed RDP without Network Level Authentication is one of the primary initial access vectors for ransomware operators.
all_checks.remediation: Disable Remote Desktop if not needed, or enforce Network Level Authentication (UserAuthentication = 1) and restrict TCP 3389 via firewall.

all_checks.title: UEFI Secure Boot Integrity Protection
all_checks.description: Verify that UEFI Secure Boot is enabled to prevent unsigned bootloaders and kernel rootkits.
all_checks.evidence: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecureBoot\State\UEFISecureBootEnabled = 1
all_checks.explanation: UEFI Secure Boot cryptographically verifies the OS bootloader before execution, blocking bootkits.
all_checks.remediation: Enable Secure Boot in the system UEFI/BIOS firmware settings.

all_checks.title: BitLocker Full Disk Encryption (OS Volume C:)
all_checks.description: Check whether the operating system drive (C:) is protected by BitLocker Drive Encryption.
all_checks.evidence: Access denied
all_checks.explanation: Full-disk encryption protects data at rest if a laptop or workstation is physically lost or stolen.
all_checks.remediation: Run WinSecAudit as Administrator to assess BitLocker, or enable BitLocker in Control Panel > BitLocker Drive Encryption.

all_checks.title: SMBv1 Legacy Protocol Deprecation
all_checks.description: Verify that the deprecated SMBv1 protocol is disabled to prevent EternalBlue-class network exploits.
all_checks.evidence: LanmanServer SMB1=0, mrxsmb10 driver state=NotInstalled.
all_checks.explanation: SMBv1 lacks modern cryptographic integrity protections and was exploited by WannaCry and NotPetya worms.
all_checks.remediation: Disable SMBv1 via 'Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol'.

checks.title: Windows Defender Antivirus & Real-Time Protection
checks.description: Verify that Windows Defender Antivirus and Real-Time Malware Protection are active.
checks.evidence: AntivirusEnabled=True, RealTimeProtectionEnabled=True, BehaviorMonitorEnabled=True, IoavProtectionEnabled=True
checks.explanation: Real-Time Protection scans files and process memory on access to block malware execution before infection occurs.
checks.remediation: Enable Real-time protection in Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings.

checks.title: Windows Defender Security Intelligence Currency
checks.description: Verify that malware definitions (Security Intelligence) have been updated within the last 3 days.
checks.evidence: Signature Version: 1.463.134.0, AntivirusSignatureAge: 0 day(s).
checks.explanation: Outdated antivirus signatures reduce detection accuracy against newly emerging ransomware and trojans.
checks.remediation: Run 'Update-MpSignature' in PowerShell or check for protection updates in Windows Security.

checks.title: Windows Defender Tamper Protection
checks.description: Verify that Tamper Protection is enabled to prevent unauthorized modification of Defender settings.
checks.evidence: IsTamperProtected = True
checks.explanation: Tamper Protection prevents malware or scripts from disabling Windows Defender via registry or PowerShell.
checks.remediation: Enable Tamper Protection in Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Manage settings.

checks.title: Windows Defender Firewall Profile Status (Domain, Private, Public)
checks.description: Verify that the host firewall is enabled across Domain, Private, and Public network profiles.
checks.evidence: Domain: Enabled=True (In:NotConfigured), Private: Enabled=True (In:NotConfigured), Public: Enabled=True (In:NotConfigured)
checks.explanation: The host firewall blocks unsolicited inbound network connections and lateral movement attempts.
checks.remediation: Enable all firewall profiles via 'Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain,Public,Private -Enabled True' (as Administrator).

checks.title: User Account Control (UAC) & Secure Desktop Configuration
checks.description: Verify that UAC is enabled and prompts administrators on the Secure Desktop before privilege elevation.
checks.evidence: EnableLUA=1, ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=5, PromptOnSecureDesktop=1.
checks.explanation: UAC prevents silent privilege escalation by requiring interactive user consent on an isolated Secure Desktop.
checks.remediation: Set UAC to 'Notify me only when apps try to make changes to my computer (default)' or higher in User Account Control Settings.

checks.title: Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) & Network Level Authentication
checks.description: Check whether Remote Desktop is disabled, or if enabled, enforces Network Level Authentication (NLA).
checks.evidence: fDenyTSConnections = 1 (Remote Desktop connections are disabled).
checks.explanation: Exposed RDP without Network Level Authentication is one of the primary initial access vectors for ransomware operators.
checks.remediation: Disable Remote Desktop if not needed, or enforce Network Level Authentication (UserAuthentication = 1) and restrict TCP 3389 via firewall.

checks.title: UEFI Secure Boot Integrity Protection
checks.description: Verify that UEFI Secure Boot is enabled to prevent unsigned bootloaders and kernel rootkits.
checks.evidence: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecureBoot\State\UEFISecureBootEnabled = 1
checks.explanation: UEFI Secure Boot cryptographically verifies the OS bootloader before execution, blocking bootkits.
checks.remediation: Enable Secure Boot in the system UEFI/BIOS firmware settings.

checks.title: BitLocker Full Disk Encryption (OS Volume C:)
checks.description: Check whether the operating system drive (C:) is protected by BitLocker Drive Encryption.
checks.evidence: Access denied
checks.explanation: Full-disk encryption protects data at rest if a laptop or workstation is physically lost or stolen.
checks.remediation: Run WinSecAudit as Administrator to assess BitLocker, or enable BitLocker in Control Panel > BitLocker Drive Encryption.

checks.title: SMBv1 Legacy Protocol Deprecation
checks.description: Verify that the deprecated SMBv1 protocol is disabled to prevent EternalBlue-class network exploits.
checks.evidence: LanmanServer SMB1=0, mrxsmb10 driver state=NotInstalled.
checks.explanation: SMBv1 lacks modern cryptographic integrity protections and was exploited by WannaCry and NotPetya worms.
checks.remediation: Disable SMBv1 via 'Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol'.

controls.name: Defender Real-Time Protection
controls.explanation: Intercepts malware execution in real time.
controls.recommendation: Keep Real-Time Protection and Behavior Monitoring enabled at all times.

controls.name: Security Intelligence Signatures
controls.explanation: Provides threat definitions for known malware families.

controls.name: Defender Tamper Protection
controls.explanation: Blocks unauthorized disabling of antivirus controls.
controls.recommendation: Enable Tamper Protection in Windows Security.

controls.name: Windows Firewall (All Profiles)
controls.evidence: Domain: Enabled=True (In:NotConfigured), Private: Enabled=True (In:NotConfigured), Public: Enabled=True (In:NotConfigured)
controls.explanation: Filters inbound and outbound network traffic across network profiles.
controls.recommendation: Keep Domain, Private, and Public firewall profiles enabled with Block Inbound default.

controls.name: User Account Control (UAC)
controls.explanation: Isolates administrative token elevation behind an interactive prompt.

controls.name: Remote Desktop (RDP)
controls.explanation: Controls remote interactive desktop sessions over port 3389.
controls.recommendation: Disable RDP on workstations or enforce NLA + VPN.

controls.name: UEFI Secure Boot
controls.explanation: Verifies cryptographic signatures of boot components.

controls.name: BitLocker Drive Encryption (C:)
controls.explanation: Encrypts the OS drive at rest using TPM + AES.
controls.recommendation: Enable BitLocker or Device Encryption on C: and back up the recovery key.

controls.name: SMBv1 Protocol Restriction
controls.explanation: Prevents legacy SMBv1 exploitation over TCP 445.
controls.recommendation: Ensure SMBv1 remains disabled and use SMBv3 with encryption.
